title: mem project current --json
description: The working directory's project (spec §5 chain, read-only). Exit 1 with nothing on stdout when this directory belongs to no project mem knows; `root` is null when the project was named with --project from outside a checkout. `verify` is present only when the project declared one with `mem project set verify` — its absence means the caller does its own detection.

model.description: Present only when the project chose its workers' model with `mem project set model`.

machine.description: This machine's name as mem spells it, the name a runner claim is compared against.

runner.description: Present only when a machine claimed the project with `mem project set runner`.

runner_since.description: When the runner claimed the project, RFC 3339; present only beside runner.

slots.description: How many tasks a run works on at once.
